paragraphs: Simplicity ILS is an integrated library system from Millonex LLC, which dates its founding to 2020. The homepage describes an ILS meant to engage patrons on their terms while simplifying staff workflows.

Cataloging covers library collections with MARC record support and holds management. Circulation tracks inventory, checkouts and returns, and lost or damaged items. Patron management covers onboarding, item requests and patron engagement. Reporting gives customizable reports on circulation trends, patron activity and collection performance.

The about page names public libraries as the market. Library staff and patrons are named as the people the system serves. The public-facing catalog is described as working on any device and offering self-service tools.

quote.text: Developed by librarians for librarians, Simplicity provides streamlined workflows to free up staff for more meaningful interactions.
